metadataReview.note: The engagement of 27 August 1813 is located at the Old Hagelberg Monument, which the Brandenburg state tourism board describes as marking the main site of the combat on the village road between Lübnitz and Hagelberg. The point is a memorial-sector reference, not a regimental position or the full battlefield. The existing date is retained and no end date is added. Strengths, losses and equipment are not inferred from these sources.

metadataReview.coordinateBasis: The TMB page 'Die Schlacht bei Hagelberg' publishes schema.org GeoCoordinates latitude 52.144532089749 and longitude 12.517916479888, rounded to [12.5179,52.1445]. The same page says the Old Monument between Lübnitz and Hagelberg 'zeigt den Hauptort des damaligen Gefechts an'. Although its address field names the summit cross, the published point lies about 6 m from OpenStreetMap node 4464604291, Altes Hagelbergdenkmal (52.1445464, 12.5178266), and about 650 m north of the Hagelberg summit. This is a memorial-based sector reference, not a surveyed troop position or the extent of the fighting. The 1955 memorial and the summit are not used, and no accuracy radius is claimed.
